media.title: A phone-driven Codex workflow reaches TestFlight through GitHub and Xcode Cloud

title: Review Voice-Requested iOS Changes in TestFlight
summary: Ro demonstrates requesting an iOS change by voice from a phone, having Codex create a GitHub pull request, and receiving an Xcode Cloud build in TestFlight roughly ten minutes later. The workflow moves human review to the installed app while GitHub and Xcode Cloud carry the implementation and delivery handoff without a laptop in the loop.
takeaway: Treat TestFlight as the remote review surface: let the agent open a pull request, let CI produce the signed build, and reserve merge approval for a human who has exercised the result.
